conflicts.permit: In such cases, the information that we share may include your name, favorite stations, and listening and usage activity.
conflicts.prohibit: NPR prohibits the third-party developers of those applications from accessing, storing or sharing any such non-public information.
conflicts.situation: When NPR shares a user's non-public information (such as name, favorite stations, and listening activity) with authorized third-party applications to provide NPR Services.
conflicts.reason: NPR expressly states it may share this non-public information with authorized third-party applications, yet immediately states it prohibits the application developers from accessing or storing it.
